name: Venomancer: Book of Shadra makes Green Salve seek every 6 sec (#2906)
contract: #2906: Book of Shadra 705957 reads 'Doubles the duration, cooldown, and healing of Green Salve. In addition, it now seeks another nearby ally to heal every 6 sec, instead of at the end of the duration.' Spell.dbc: Green Salve 800902 effect 1 is aura 227 with a 5999 ms period and duration index 32 (6 s); the three 705957 effects are aura 108 with BasePoints 99 (+100%), which lengthen it to 12 s. The seek heal 803529 was cast by aura_ascension_venomancer_lifecycle behind a once-only ScriptValue guard, so a 12 s salve seeked once. The guard is now skipped while the caster has 705957. The baseline in the same run (Book unlearned) must seek exactly once; with the Book learned two seeks are required. Free instant 800902 needs no resource.

steps.label: SETUP: Book of Shadra is not yet active
Green Salve is applied on the ally for the base 6 s
Let the base 6 s aura run out
BASELINE: without Book the salve seeks another ally exactly once
Book of Shadra passive is active
With Book the salve lasts 12 s
Let both 6 s ticks and the aura end pass
Book of Shadra: the salve seeks another ally on each of the two 6 s ticks
